# SashaSMP Modpack

SashaSMP Modpack is a Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack made for the SashaSMP server.

The pack is focused on Create-based engineering, vehicles, trains, airships, exploration, bosses, food, farming, fishing, dungeons, and survival progression. It includes Create Aeronautics, Create add-ons, Farmer's Delight add-ons, world generation mods, hostile mobs, underwater content, cave threats, quality-of-life features, performance improvements, and visual client-side enhancements.

## Main Features

- Create and many Create add-ons for factories, trains, vehicles, automation, and advanced machinery
- Create Aeronautics and related vehicle/physics mods
- Expanded farming, cooking, and food progression with Farmer's Delight add-ons
- Extra fishing and ocean content
- New bosses, dungeons, mobs, and dangerous exploration
- Overworld, Nether, End, and custom-dimension content
- Client optimization mods for better FPS and smoother gameplay
- Useful quality-of-life tools like JEI, Jade, inventory helpers, minimap-style utilities, and visual improvements
- Simple Voice Chat support for the SashaSMP server
